title: What do you guys do when your attention span is having a dip that you cannot force yourself to sit through or concentrate watching any movie ever?

commenti.body: [removed]

This has happened to me over the last ten years. I know what the answer is: stop using my damn phone for anything other than texting and calling. It’s not just social media, it’s the immediate gratification of looking up whatever my mind Desires that has crushed my attention span.

I have adhd, I get this a lot but it's like my normal state. Generally the problem is movies are understimulating, some of my friends with adhd will do things like knit during movies, for me I can get away with just having the right textures to feel and it adds enough stimulation that I can focus on the movie, but not so much that I can't.

> some of my friends with adhd will do things like knit during movies

I need to try this. sometimes I do light exercise but you can only do so much.
[removed]

I take a break from movies and read a book instead.  When I'm reading, I have more control over the pace of the experience (books certainly have their own pacing, but the reader drives the actual process), so I'm not relying on my attention to passively take it in without wandering.

As long as I'm reading regularly, I don't typically have problems settling my mind in for movies.  It's when I get too caught up in other things and don't read that I have trouble focusing on linear narratives.

I’m someone who has a hard time sitting still and focusing on something unless I’m very interested in said thing. Then I hyper focus. For me films achieve that level of hyper focus. I love focusing on the story and the technical aspects of the film while watching. Trying to analyze it to the best of my ability. This is why I love the theater. No distractions.
[removed]

Ok so I have adhd, so this happens to me a LOT. And I mean, usually I take vyvanse and obviously that helps. But I also haven’t refilled my prescription in three months so right now, when I find myself unable to focus, I drink black tea or vape. Which isn’t the healthiest, but stimulants help you pay attention so caffeine and nicotine are good. I’ll also just set my phone in another room and like close the door on the room I’m in when I’m trying to watch a movie, so I don’t have any distractions and I’ll be forced to pay attention to the movie and I’ll become engrossed in it. And lastly, I find that my attention span is worst when I’m stressed out and sleep deprived. So if you haven’t been getting enough sleep, catch up on your sleep, then watch whatever movie you’ve been meaning to watch ! Or if you’re stressed out, try to do something that relaxes you before watching the movie. So yeah, caffeine, nicotine, rest and relaxation. One of those things should work for you.
So true, fucking sucks. Sometimes I'll literally throw my phone into the other room so it's out of reach.
Getting Vyvanse prescription refilled was always a major hassle for me. Treated me like I was a criminal. Every script had to have a fucking doctor's appointment, every 30 days. Completely Absurd.
